subject: general
question: As of October 2020, which of the following authors of Indian origin has NOT won the Man Booker Prize for literature?
solution:
The correct option is __**Jhumpa Lahiri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Booker Prize** is also known as the** Booker Prize for Fiction** or T**he Man Booker Prize**.
 
• In 2014 it was widened to any English-language novel but before that novels written by Commonwealth, Irish, and South African citizens were eligible to receive the prize.
 
• **Nilanjana Sudeshna "Jhumpa" Lahiri** was born on **July 11, 1967**.
 
• She is an American author known for her short stories, novels and essays in English.
 
• Some of her novels include **"The Namesake" (2003), "The Lowland" (2013), "Whereabouts" (2021)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first booker prize was given in **1969**.
 
• In **1970**, **Bernice Rubens** became the first woman to win the Booker Prize, for **"The Elected Member"**.
 
• **Alice Munro's,** **"The Beggar Maid"** was shortlisted in** 1980** and remained the only short story collection to be shortlisted.
 
• **Kiran Desai** is an Indian author.Her novel **"The Inheritance of Loss"** won the **2006 Man Booker Prize**.
 
• **Arundhati Roy **is an Indian author best known for her novel** "The God of Small Things"**, which won the** Man Booker Prize for Fiction in 1997.**
 
• **Aravind Adiga** is an Indian writer and journalist. His debut novel, **"The White Tiger"**, won the **2008 Man Booker Prize**.
